[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to build courage to end a toxic relationship:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Recognize the signs of a toxic relationship, including controlling behavior, emotional abuse, manipulation, and gaslighting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Set clear boundaries to express needs and expectations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Seek support from family, friends, or a support group.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Plan an exit strategy, considering the best way, time, and place to end the relationship.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Focus on self-care after ending the relationship, including surrounding oneself with positivity, exercising, meditating, and engaging in joyful activities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ending a toxic relationship is necessary for personal growth and well-being.
